title: Anchor V/H_off track precompute — input
description: Pure-compute input. Caller supplies per-window labels for a contiguous chromosome range plus a list of anchor window indices. The compute emits V(anchor_w, w), H_off(anchor_w, w), K_w(anchor_w, w) tracks per anchor. Downstream consumers cache the result and query via getV / getHoff.

anchors.description: Window indices to use as anchors. Each anchor produces one V/H_off track over the chromosome range.

s_window.description: Lower bound of the tracking range. Defaults to min(windows[].idx).
